description: GCP Vertex AI metadata connector (Tier-3, no-row-data). Indexes Vertex AI model REGISTRY metadata only — model resource name, display name, version id, region, and create/update timestamps — via the gcloud CLI's `gcloud ai models list/describe` commands. Never calls inference / prediction: there is no `gcloud ai endpoints predict`, no `explain`, no `raw-predict`, and no batch-prediction output read. Reuses the existing GCP service-account credentials via the gcloud CLI; region defaults to us-central1 (optional `gcp.region`). Read-only; no write tools.
author: Nimbus
